concepts.learning_objective: Describe a magnetic field and how its direction at a point is fixed using a compass needle.
State and apply the properties of magnetic field lines of a bar magnet.

topics.title: Magnetic field due to a current through a straight conductor

concepts.learning_objective: Recognise that a current-carrying straight wire produces a magnetic field of concentric circles around it.
Explain how the field of a straight wire depends on the current and on the distance from the wire.
Use the right-hand thumb rule to find the direction of the magnetic field around a current-carrying conductor.

topics.title: Magnetic field of a circular loop and a solenoid

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the magnetic field of a current-carrying circular loop and coil.
Describe the magnetic field inside and around a current-carrying solenoid.
Explain how a solenoid is used to make an electromagnet.

topics.title: Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the factors that decide the direction and size of the force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.
Apply Fleming's left-hand rule to find the direction of force on a conductor or moving charge.
Describe the wires, supply values and parallel connection used in domestic circuits.
Explain the role of the earth wire as a safety measure.
Explain short-circuiting and overloading and how a fuse protects a circuit.
